maddeler.e:
اغتدوا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَدَوْا (iḡtadaw) /iɣ.ta.daw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اُغْتُدُوا (uḡtudū) /uɣ.tu.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اِغْتَدُوا (iḡtadū) /iɣ.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
